_doc: Meanwhile, Inside (the human-body channel): 'surgical green'. Read by kits/cinema/film/page.mjs (tokens → --<name>, roles → --hud-<role>, fonts → @font-face, type → --font-<role>, safe, captionY, cssText) and by kits/cinema/sci/contrast.py (tokens, scene, labels, contrast). Hexes are the bible's (films/channels/body/bible.md §2) with the cross-check's fixes: O₂ is white with an 'O₂' glyph and a ring, CO₂ is slate, immune gets a dashed ring, lining is sage, the title's accent word is chartreuse (pulse stays on blood only), and the rim light is mint. Sizes are px at 1080×1920; the roles carry the same sizes in vmin (px / 10.8), so a 540×960 draft is the final at half size. Not Lumevina (no rose or gold on black, no Inter, no glass bells), not Los Güeros, not Claude coral: contrast.py checks the distances.
name: Meanwhile, Inside
promise: What your body is doing right now, while you watch.

scene._doc: 3D materials and lights only: never text, never CSS. Tissue and vessel are lit under the green hemisphere so they always read warm against green and never sit on near-black (cross-check). Only signal and pulse bloom.
scene.lights: hemisphere #DDF3EC / #0A1F1C at 0.5; warm key #FFF1E6 at 2.2 from the top right; mint rim #CFF5E6 at 1.4 from behind (was pink #FF8FA0: too close to Skin School's recipe)

highlight._doc: The word being spoken turns chartreuse on the plate; words still to come are text-2, words said are text.

type._doc: Display: Fraunces 144pt SuperSoft SemiBold (wght 600, opsz 144, SOFT 100; set in cssText), for titles and static numbers. Text: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, 700 captions, 600 labels, 400–500 secondary. Counters and badges use Atkinson with tabular figures (tnum), because Fraunces has proportional figures only (no tnum: a running counter would jitter). Atkinson has no subscript figures, so the '₂' in the O₂/CO₂ glyphs falls back to DejaVu Sans (the page's system-safe stack), never to Inter. Both files ship unmodified (Atkinson reserves its names).

sizes._doc: px at 1080×1920. Captions: at most 2 lines of at most 24 characters (kits/cinema/script pages them with max_chars = 24); the size is the largest whole px at which the widest of the 142 rows of all three episode-1 scripts (paged at 24 characters) fits the plate's maximum width, 0.72 × W = 778 px, without hud.js shrinking it. Measured in Chromium with this face on 2026-10-22: it fits up to 55.3 px; at 55 px the widest row ('balls down the same way.') makes a 772 px plate. The studio plan's 56–72 px was set for 32-character lines. Labels: the pill is at least 0.035 × H = 67 px tall.

labels._doc: Every label names its part in words; the colour goes on the dot (or ring) and the pill border, so colour is never the only cue. The pill is opaque surface (label-bg), so deoxy keeps its 3.25:1 over any frame (at 94% it fell to 2.71:1 over a white bloom; contrast.py). O₂ (white) and immune (cream) sit ΔE 7.9 apart, so O₂ has a solid ring and immune a dashed one.

deoxy.use: oxygen-poor blood; the dot gets a white ring (3.25:1 on surface on its own)

contrast._doc: What contrast.py checks besides the automatic pairs (text, captions, labels, badges, scrim). grounds: the flat colours text can sit on. behind: what the caption plate, label pills and badges can sit over (worst case first).

pairs.note: dark text on a chartreuse button or chip
the whoa number, on the plain ground
the whoa number on a card
pulse is never text on the glow (about 4.5:1 there); lines only
the pulse line on the ground
the pulse line over the glow

motif.signature_shape: The pulse line: one chartreuse (signal) ECG-like trace that blips lub-dub under the Fraunces title on the sonic signature. The same line draws the label leaders, the scale bar and the iris edge.
motif.no_circle: No circle anywhere: no circular title frame, end card, avatar or iris (the space channel owns the ring). The locator is a 2D SVG body silhouette with the region marked by a pulse-line blip on the beat.
motif.iris: Scale changes go through a non-circular iris: a soft membrane-blob mask or a vertical slide wipe, plus a scale pill ('×2,000 · 10 µm').
motif.title_card: Fraunces title (accent word in signal), the pulse line under it, 'Meanwhile, Inside · No. 01' below; the payoff image behind. It is also the poster and the loop point.
motif.end_card: The pulse line flat-lines into 'Next, inside: …', then 'Follow Meanwhile, Inside'. Held ≥ 2 s.
motif.recurring_segment: The 'Meanwhile' tally: a real-time counter of what your body did while you watched ('while you watched: about 85 heartbeats'), set in Atkinson with tabular figures.
motif.colour_rules: Pulse (#FF6688) is for blood only. Signal (chartreuse) is nerve signals, the spoken word, the pulse line and the title's accent word. Only signal and pulse bloom; text never does.
motif.sound: E♭ major at 75 BPM (resting heart rate); mallet ostinato on the lub-dub; signature thump E♭2, thump B♭2 at +0.4 s, mallet G5 at +1.2 s (no bell).
